note: rustre-ttd-replay is a workspace library crate (Time-Travel Debugging deterministic replay engine: TracePosition, MemoryState/MemPage/MemDiff, Watchpoint/ReplayBreakpoint with BreakpointCondition variants, SnapshotCache, ReplayEngine forward/backward navigation, query APIs find_first/last/all_writes_to and find_all_calls_to, TtdRecordingFile binary format with magic RSTRETTD v1). It is NOT exposed via the MCP server: no references to ttd-replay/TtdReplay/ReplayEngine in crates/rustre-mcp-tools. JSON-RPC stdio comparison against rustre-mcp.exe is therefore N/A; the pure-logic Python validator IS the ground-truth comparison.

checked_against_source.MemoryState: page-aligned writes, cross-page split, diff over union of page bases
checked_against_source.WatchpointKind: Read | Write | ReadWrite with overlap = !(end<=base || start>=base+size)
